name: dero-docs-monorepo
description: Monorepo for DERO, TELA, and DeroPay documentation sites

scripts.build:all: npm run build:derod && npm run build:tela && npm run build:deropay
scripts.install:all: cd derod-main && npm install && cd ../tela-main && npm install && cd ../deropay-main && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf derod-main/.next derod-main/out tela-main/.next tela-main/out deropay-main/.next deropay-main/out
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf derod-main/node_modules tela-main/node_modules deropay-main/node_modules node_modules

author: DERO & TELA Community
